capabilities: Sync Bases notes with Google Sheets rows in both directions
Map sheet columns to frontmatter properties with typed coercion
Preview note creation, row creation and field conflicts before applying
Resolve conflicts by asking, or letting Sheets or Obsidian win
Connect through a built-in Apps Script template without Google Cloud Console
extras: Quick Mode avoids Google Cloud Console by having the user deploy a Google Apps Script web app with a SECRET_TOKEN and paste its URL into plugin settings.
problem: Bases notes and spreadsheet data drift apart because Obsidian has no built-in way to exchange rows with Google Sheets.

relations.evidence: Two-way synchronization between Obsidian Bases notes (frontmatter properties) and Google Sheets.
Connect any Google Sheet in 1 minute using the built-in Google Apps Script template.

summary: Two-way sync tool that keeps Obsidian Bases notes and Google Sheets rows aligned, with column mapping and a conflict preview.
